title: git: parse Git Protocol version from pkt-lines
description:
In Git's packfile transfer protocol[1], the initial server response
contains the version of the Git Protocol in use; version 1 or version 2
[2].

Parse out this information following up on work started in MR !805 [3]
by Izabela Bakollari and advice provided by Ronnie Sahlberg, add it as a
field for ease of reading and filtering.

[1] https://www.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/docs/technical/pack-protocol.html

[2] https://www.kernel.org/pub/software/scm/git/docs/technical/protocol-v2.html

[3] https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/805


Related to #17093

notes.body: consider using tvb_strneql() instead

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/1714/diffs?diff_id=137752106&start_sha=f971b81fda26fa15382720661351c28bb5607247#af0057bee6b1c65490fa9248f7a79e62a59dd7a2_125_125)
you can use directly proto_tree_add_item() instead of manually fetching the byte and using proto_tree_add_uint()

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/1714/diffs?diff_id=137735193&start_sha=d81b069fd405744ae6751b2d1f99414616a501b8#af0057bee6b1c65490fa9248f7a79e62a59dd7a2_128_128)

added 1 commit
  • f971b81f - git: parse Git Protocol version from pkt-lines
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/1714/diffs?diff_id=137735193&start_sha=d81b069fd405744ae6751b2d1f99414616a501b8)
This is wrong. You need to stop fetching protocol_version manually and use     proto_tree_add_item(git_tree, hf_git_protocol_version, tvb, offset + 8, 1, ENC_NA);

The 49 here reads as a "magic number": it's not easy to see at a glance where the number comes from. Would it make sense to use

```
#define GIT_VERSION_ONE '1'
```

Or even simpler, to use `'1'` in place in version_vals?

changed this line in [version 4 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/1714/diffs?diff_id=137755357&start_sha=1ae1ee4cb8b3bdca71d9e21f07434c1674f5d4c6#af0057bee6b1c65490fa9248f7a79e62a59dd7a2_43_43)
Done

I wondered for a moment whether this should be FT_CHAR since we parse it as ASCII, but if I'm reading the description of VALS in doc/README.dissector correctly, then FT_UINT8 is right for this setup.

I suspect, though, that it would be more natural to get the value using a tvb helper as a string and convert to an integer using ws_strtoi32, since it's not guaranteed to be a single character.
Since we decided to keep parsing as a char, and use proto_tree_add_item as suggested, this change won't be implemented. Marking as resolved.
